name: PageLoadingLine
description: The line along the bottom edge of a page's top bar while the page under it loads (page-loading-line.md). Place it inside the bar, which must be `relative`. The consumer owns the load; the line owns its timing: it shows only after 200ms, only moves forward, rests at 8% while there is no progress, and stops at 95% until the load ends, then fills and fades.

props.name: failed
props.description: The load ended in an error: the line goes at once instead of filling and fading.

props.name: loading
props.description: True while the page loads. Turning it on again starts a new load.

props.name: value
props.description: How far the page has loaded, 0 to 100. Leave it out while the page reports none.
